headerDisplay: Control [blocky](https://0xerr0r.github.io/blocky/) DNS blocking from HomeKit or Matter. You get a switch that turns blocking on and off, plus one "pause" switch for each duration listed below.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the main switch. Pause switches are named "Pause <Name> 5 Minutes" and so on.

url.title: Blocky URL
url.description: Base URL of blocky's HTTP listener (ports.http in blocky's config). Leave off the /api path.

pauseMinutes.title: Pause durations (minutes)
pauseMinutes.description: Each entry adds a switch that pauses blocking for that many minutes. Leave empty to show only the on/off switch.

groups.title: Blocking groups
groups.description: Only disable these blocky groups (as named under blocking.denylists in blocky's config). Leave empty to disable all groups.

pollInterval.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to check blocky's status, so changes made elsewhere show up. Set to 0 to turn polling off.

matterDeviceType.title: Matter device type
matterDeviceType.description: How the switches look to Matter controllers. Only applies when Matter is on for this bridge. If your controller doesn't support Switch, use Outlet. Changing this re-creates the Matter accessories.
